QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: weitongAircraftEnabled
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Enable Weitong aircraft satellite-antenna TCP control.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: When enabled, the ground station connects to the high-altitude satellite antenna and shows antenna control buttons on the Fly view.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Weitong aircraft

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: satcomHost
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: IPv4 address of the antenna server. Protocol default is 192.168.0.200.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Antenna host

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: satcomPort
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: TCP port of the antenna server. Protocol default is 23.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Antenna port
